title: Morley Simplices in Higher Dimensions: Regularity, Reflections, and Counterexamples
summary: Trisecting the dihedral angles of an $n$-simplex defines its Morley simplex. We study the original simplices for which this simplex is regular. A criterion in terms of the Gram matrix of the facet normals reduces the problem to a matrix equation. The derivative of the Morley map at the regular simplex has two explicit eigenvalues, both nonzero for $n\ge3$; thus the regular simplex is an isolated solution.
